excluded_examples.headline: haaretz/n12/themarker/ynet/walla/kan/mako/i24: ~340 of the day's remaining unique top-20 items were election-eve/election-day political reporting, campaign coverage, the Netanyahu-Zamir friction story, the Hebron operation, Brazil's Lula-Bolsonaro runoff, Serbia's Vucic defeat, and general news/entertainment/sport with no citable source carrying a specific empirical claim

note: Extremely thin day for data stories: Oct 27 is Israeli election day, and the 2-day window (Oct 26-27) is dominated almost entirely by election-eve/election-day political coverage (Netanyahu-Zamir Iran friction, Hebron operation, campaign logistics) plus the Brazil (Lula-Bolsonaro) and Serbia (Vucic) election results, none of which rest on a citable study/report with a specific empirical claim per the detect exclusions. Of 430 unique unaudited top-20 headlines across the 8 reachable outlets (ynet, n12/mako, walla, kan, haaretz, themarker, i24, globes; israelhayom/ch14/makorrishon/calcalist remained blocked per CLAUDE.md known-blocked list), only 4 stood out as genuine data stories, each single-outlet with no cross-outlet cluster found: two ESMO/NEJM oncology trials covered by ynet (Krascendo 1 lung-cancer KRAS G12C trial and CLARITY-Gastric01 stomach-cancer trial), a Walla lung-cancer-treatment-survival piece whose body could not be fetched (walla returned a 301 redirect to its homepage on every attempt - recorded body_ok=0, to be retried by the audit subagent), a TheMarker piece on Haredi employment-incentive funding failing to raise employment (paywalled, only headline/summary/caption visible, body_ok=0), and a mako piece on a Harvard Business School/Tel Aviv University working paper (Prof. Itai Ater, LinkedIn data 2015-2024) finding the return rate of hi-tech workers and Unit 8200 alumni from abroad roughly halved 2022-2024.
